$comment: Machine-readable catalog of the EFI fiscalization service messages. See message-catalog.md.

meta.statusNote: Generated mechanically from the official WSDL and XSD served by the EFI test environment; the XSD served by the production environment is byte-identical (see sources/README.md).

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: RegisterInvoiceRequest
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Root XML element representing register invoice message.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Id
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Attribute used for signature creation and verification.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Version
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Attribute used to specify compliance with XSD schema.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Header
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing header of the invoice containing data about the message (request) sent.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: UUID
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: UUID generated by a TCR for every register sale data message send to the CIS.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SendDateTime
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Date and time of sending the register invoice data message from a TCR to the CIS.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SubseqDelivType
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of subsequent delivery if message is delivered after invoice issuance.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Invoice
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing a single invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: InvType
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: The type of invoice, the financial document, that is being fiscalized.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TypeOfInv
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of the item represents the type of invoice item, e.g. regular sale or a returned item.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TypeOfSelfIss
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of self-issuing.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IssueDateTime
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Date and time of invoice created and issued at TCR.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: InvNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Invoice number composed of invoice ordinal number, year of invoice issuance and code of TCR that issued invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: InvOrdNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Invoice ordinal number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TCRCode
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Code of the device that issued the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IsIssuerInVAT
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Is the taxpayer in the VAT system.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TaxFreeAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Amount on the invoice that is tax free.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: MarkUpAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Amount of the mark-up on the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: GoodsExAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total price of delivery of exported goods. There is no VAT on the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TotPriceWoVAT
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total price of the invoice without VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TotVATAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total VAT amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TotPrice
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total price of the invoice including VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TotPriceToPay
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total price that customer pays.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: OperatorCode
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Reference to the operator who is operating on TCR. Value represents code of the operator.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: BusinUnitCode
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Code (ID) of the business unit in which the invoice is issued.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SoftCode
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Number of the software used for invoice issuing.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IIC
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Issuers’s invoice code which is generated by the cash register of the issuer of the invoice. This is a unique code for every invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IICSignature
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Signed issuer’s invoice code concatenated parameters.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IsReverseCharge
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer is obliged to pay taxes by himself rather than issuer does it for him.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PayDeadline
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Last day for a payment.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ParagonBlockNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Number of paragon block.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TaxPeriod
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Tax period for tax return.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: BankAccNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: The number of the giro account to which the customer needs to pay the amount to pay the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Note
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Note on the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SupplyDateOrPeriod
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing supply date or period is supply is different from the date when the invoice was issued.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Start
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Start date.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: End
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: End date.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: CorrectiveInv
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element groups data for a corrective invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IICRef
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: IIC reference on the original invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IssueDateTime
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Date and time the original invoice is created and issued at TCR

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Type
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of the corrective invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PayMethods
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of payment methods.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PayMethod
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing one payment method.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Type
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of the payment method.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Amt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Amount payed by payment method in the country currency.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: CompCard
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Company card number if the payment method is company cards.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: AdvIIC
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: IIC of the advance invoice from which part of the invoice is paid.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: BankAcc
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Bank account number to which the return is made.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Vouchers
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of voucher numbers if the payment method is voucher.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Voucher
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing a single voucher number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Num
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing single voucher serial number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Currency
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing currency in which the amount on the invoice is expressed.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Code
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Currency code from the ISO 4217 standard.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ExRate
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Exchange rate applied to calculate the equivalent amount of foreign currency for the total amount expressed in EUR. Exchange rate express equivalent amount of EUR for 1 unit of foreign currency.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Seller
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing an seller of the goods.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IDType
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's identification number type.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IDNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's identification number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Name
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's name.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Address
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's address.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Town
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's town.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Country
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Seller's country.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Buyer
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing a buyer of the goods.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IDType
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's identification number type.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IDNum
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's identification number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Name
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's name.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Address
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's address.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Town
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's town.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Country
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Buyer's country.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TIC
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Tax identification card number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Items
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of invoice items (goods or services).

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: I
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Element representing a single item on the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: N
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Name of the item.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: C
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Code of the item.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: U
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Unit of measure for specific item – piece, weight, length...

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Q
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Amount or number (quantity) of items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: UPB
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Price of one item before VAT is applied (unit price without VAT).

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: UPA
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Price of one item after VAT is applied (unit price with VAT). It is calculated as PA/Q.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: R
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Rebate percentage.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: RR
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Is rebate reducing base price?

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PB
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Price before VAT for the items in this group of items. This is not the unit price of the item. It is the unit price multiplied by the quantity of items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VR
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Rate of value added tax expressed as percentage.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VA
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Amount of value added tax for the items in this group of items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IN
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: If true, the item is investment.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PA
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Price after applying VAT for the items in this group of items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: EX
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Exempt from VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VD
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Expiration date of the voucher.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VSN
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing single voucher serial number.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SameTaxes
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of items of the same VAT rate.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: SameTax
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Element representing an item of list of same tax items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: NumOfItems
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Number of items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: PriceBefVAT
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Price before VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VATRate
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: VAT rate.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ExemptFromVAT
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Exempt from VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VATAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: VAT amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Approvals
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing an approval list for credit note.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Approval
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Element representing approval for a single tax rate.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: DiscountAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Discount amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ReturnAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Return amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VATRate
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: VAT rate.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ExemptFromVAT
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Exempt from VAT.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: VATAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: VAT amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: TotalAmt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Total amount.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Fees
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of fees.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Fee
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Element representing an item of list of fee items.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Type
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Type of the fee.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Amt
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: The decimal amount of the fee in the country currency.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IICRefs
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing list of invoices IIC referenced by a invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IICRef
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing a single IIC reference on the list of IICRefs.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IIC
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: IIC of the invoice that is referenced by the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IssueDateTime
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Date and time the invoice referenced by the invoice is created and issued at TCR.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: Amount
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: The amount of the invoice referred to in the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: BadDebtInv
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element groups data for an original invoice that will be declared bad debt invoice, as uncollectible.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IICRef
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: IIC reference on the original invoice.

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: IssueDateTime
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: Date and time the original invoice is created and issued at TCR

RegisterInvoiceRequest.name: ds:Signature
RegisterInvoiceRequest.doc: XML element representing signature for the invoice.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: RegisterInvoiceResponse
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Root XML element representing register invoice response message.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: Id
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Identification of the response, used to reference a signature.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: Header
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Element representing the header of the message.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: UUID
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Element generated by the CIS for every message sent to the TCR. It uniquely identifies the message sent to the TCR.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: RequestUUID
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Element generated by the TCR and referenced by the CIS. It uniquely identifies the request message for which response message was sent to the TCR.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: SendDateTime
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: Element represents date and time of sending the response message to the TCR.

RegisterInvoiceResponse.name: FIC
RegisterInvoiceResponse.doc: CIS generated verification code that can be used to uniquely identify registered invoice.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: RegisterCashDepositRequest
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Root XML element representing cash deposit request message.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: Id
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Identification of the request, used to reference a signature.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: Header
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element representing the header of the message.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: UUID
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element generated by the TCR. It uniquely identifies the request message sent from TCR to CIS.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: SendDateTime
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element represents date and time of sending the request message to the CIS.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: SubseqDelivType
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Type of subsequent delivery if message is delivered after cash deposit issuance.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: CashDeposit
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element representing a single cash deposit request.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: ChangeDateTime
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element representing date and time when the deposit of cash was checked in the cash register.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: Operation
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: This is an XML element that represents the operation made at the cash register.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: CashAmt
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element representing the amount of cash found in the cash register after the operation.

RegisterCashDepositRequest.name: TCRCode
RegisterCashDepositRequest.doc: Element representing the unique code of the TCR in question.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: RegisterCashDepositResponse
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Root XML element representing cash deposit response message.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: Id
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Identification of the response, used to reference a signature.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: Header
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Element representing the header of the message.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: UUID
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Element generated by the CIS. It uniquely identifies the response message sent from CIS to TCR.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: RequestUUID
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Element generated by the TCR and referenced by the CIS. It uniquely identifies the request message for which response message was sent to the TCR.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: SendDateTime
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Element represents date and time of sending the response message to the TCR.

RegisterCashDepositResponse.name: FCDC
RegisterCashDepositResponse.doc: Fiscalization cash deposit code generated by the CIS.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: RegisterTCRRequest
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Root XML element representing TCR request message.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: Id
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Identification of the request, used to reference a signature.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: Header
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Element representing the header of the message.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: UUID
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Element generated by the TCR. It uniquely identifies the request message sent from TCR to CIS.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: SendDateTime
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Element represents date and time of sending the request message to the CIS.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: TCR
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: XML element representing a single TCR registration message.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: BusinUnitCode
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Code of the business unit in which the invoice is issued.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: TCRIntID
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Element representing the internal identification of the TCR.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: SoftCode
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Code of the software used for invoice issuing.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: MaintainerCode
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Code of the maintainer of the software used for invoice issuing.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: ValidFrom
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Date from which the TCR will be used.

RegisterTCRRequest.name: ValidTo
RegisterTCRRequest.doc: Date until the TCR will be used.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: RegisterTCRResponse
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Root XML element representing TCR response message.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: Id
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Identification of the response, used to reference a signature.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: Header
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Element representing the header of the message.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: UUID
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Element generated by the CIS. It uniquely identifies the response message sent from CIS to TCR.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: RequestUUID
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Element generated by the TCR and referenced by the CIS. It uniquely identifies the request message for which the response message was sent to the TCR.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: SendDateTime
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: Element represents date and time of sending the response message to the TCR.

RegisterTCRResponse.name: TCRCode
RegisterTCRResponse.doc: TCR code generated by the service.

DecimalSType.doc: Decimal number with two numbers after decimal point.

Decimal4SType.doc: Decimal number with two to four numbers after decimal point.

enum.doc: The previous agreement between the parties.
Credit and debit card issued to the physical person
Credit and debit card issued to the taxpayer
Seller's company cards, gift cards and similar prepaid cards
Invoice not yet paid. It will be paid by summary invoice.

UTCSType.doc: Date and time represented as UTC time with ISO 8601 format.

UUIDSType.doc: UUID constructed according to the RFC4122 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4122).

InvNumSType.doc: Invoice number composed of Business unit code, Invoice ordinal number, year of invoice issuing and TCR code.

DecimalNegSType.doc: Decimal number that can be written as negative number.

Decimal4NegSType.doc: Decimal number that can be written as negative number (2-4 decimals).

RegistrationCodeSType.doc: Registration code in two letters - three numbers - two letters - three number format.

DoubleNegForQuantitySType.doc: Double number for quantity fields that can be written as negative number.

TaxPeriodSType.doc: Tax period composed of month and year for which it is applied, in the format MM/YYYY.

enum.doc: Amount of cash withdrawn from the TCR.
Other fees that are not listed here.
Corrective invoice for the original invoice that has been fiscalized but ended up in error after subsequent checks.
Examination for subject of VAT taxation.
Tax base and correction of the tax base.
Exemptions for temporary importation of products.

SubseqDelivTypeSType.doc: Type of subsequent delivery if message is delivered after issuance.

enum.doc: When TCR operates in the area where there is no Internet available.
When TCR is not working and message cannot be created with TCR.
When there is an issue with the fiscalization service that blocks fiscalization.
When there is a temporary technical error at TCR side that prevents successful fiscalization.
When there is a subsequent sending conditioned by the way of doing business that prevents successful fiscalization.

CountryCodeSType.doc: Country codes from ISO 3166-1 alpha3 standard
